10._section_summary: This discussion reports that the BSRS (Breast Size Rating Scale) has adequate convergent validity and 15-day test-retest reliability in a sample of Brazilian university women, with breast size ratings correlating moderately with bra band size and breast-size dissatisfaction correlating with BMI and body-image measures.
